name: axiom
description: Guidance-first Codex engineering with Main-owned decisions, direct-spawn Luna MAX workers, Sol XHIGH review continuity, context isolation, adaptive convergence, and safe Git coordination.

interface.longDescription: Axiom is a guidance-first Codex plugin for non-trivial software engineering. It keeps intent, architecture, integration, and final acceptance in the Main Sol agent; delegates bounded work to direct-spawn Luna MAX workers; starts independent review with a fresh direct-spawn Sol XHIGH reviewer and reuses that reviewer for follow-up; and converges through Main adjudication and stable findings rather than numeric caps. It applies proactively without forcing phases, route declarations, state machines, or custom-agent installation.
defaultPrompt: Use $axiom:axiom to implement this change with efficient delegation and independent review.
Use $axiom:axiom to investigate this codebase while keeping Main context concise.
Use $axiom:axiom to finish and review this non-trivial change safely.
